buildLabel: worktree build identifier supplied by the operator

historyWorkspace.note: cwd used when this suite creates its own fixture sessions through POST /api/chat

historySession.sessionId: sessionId of a session with >=2 stored user messages (prepared through the public composer)
historySession.sessionSearchMarker: a marker that appears inside one of its stored user messages (sidebar search text)
historySession.projectName: the project folder name shown in the app banner (fixture-workspace-r2528 by default)

runningSession.sessionId: sessionId of a session whose turn is still running when this case executes
runningSession.howToPrepare: point one instance provider at an endpoint that accepts TCP and never answers, start a turn, then run this case while it hangs

historyUi.opEntryName: visible label of the UI entry that starts a history operation (contract fixes only the result entry 查看备份, not this one)

stubProvider.providerId: id of the instance's non-official provider used for the upstream-catalog case
stubProvider.model: model id the stub directory will advertise

workerEntry.note: R26 external entry; read-only inspection only, this suite never starts a worker
